name: visionboard
description: Use the complete VisionBoard OAuth MCP contract for approved direction, governed creation, review, Boards, and human-led Goal Runs.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex or ChatGPT Work to the complete VisionBoard OAuth MCP contract and a native conversation workspace backed by the same exact data and actions as the product. Read permissioned Direction and exact revisions; create attributed Draft Notes, Goals, Documents, Brand Kits, Products, Images, and Boards; work with review comments and human approval packets; prepare human-authorized Visions; and continue human-activated Goals through bounded evidence cycles. VisionBoard keeps approval, access, and Goal completion under human control.
defaultPrompt: Read my approved Vision and identify the next priority.
Create a review-ready Draft from my approved direction.
Continue the next due VisionBoard Goal Run.
